summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature in rich/progress.py (module-level functions, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file, private _BinaryReader and _ProgressContext helpers), added tests to tests/test_progress.py, a "Reading from a file" and "Reading from a file-like object" docs section in docs/source/progress.rst, and a CHANGELOG.md entry linking PR 1759. Changes are insertions only and uncommitted. Not verified: I could not run pytest, mypy, or black, per the instructions. Deviations to review: the reader defines mode and name properties (typing.IO declares them abstract, which would block instantiation); the module-level open implementation takes mode as Any so it can call the Literal-only Progress.open overloads; the return-value/type-var suppression on module-level open may be unused.
